load_scheduler_from_pretrained: load a diffusers scheduler from a pretrained model on the Hugging Face Hub using SchedulerMixin.from_pretrained
save_scheduler_pretrained: save a diffusers scheduler configuration to a local directory using SchedulerMixin.save_pretrained
get_scheduler_compatibles: get all compatible scheduler classes for a given scheduler using the compatibles property
create_scheduler_output: create a SchedulerOutput dataclass instance with a prev_sample torch tensor for the denoising loop
list_karras_diffusion_schedulers: list all KarrasDiffusionSchedulers enum values including DDIM, DPM, Euler, and Heun schedulers
